minutes.headline: Zoning board granted a special permit for two street hockey rinks at 691 Chase Road; vote count not audible
minutes.summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals heard an application from Richard and Arlene Bro for a special permit to build two street hockey rinks in the commercial district. Members asked about parking, the well and porta-potties, lighting, hours and buffers. A motion to approve with the revised hours was made and seconded, and the chair read the standard conditions.

votes.motion: Approve the special permit as requested, with hours amended to 3 p.m. to 10 p.m. Monday through Friday and 7:30 a.m. to 8 or 9 p.m. weekends

budget_items.what_was_said: The applicant described the cost per rink and the plastic surface, and said he would reinvest early income to build the second rink.
The applicant said he would charge less per child than other local rinks.

decisions.decision: Hours of operation set at 3 p.m. to 10 p.m. weekdays and 7:30 a.m. to the evening on weekends, expanded from the original request.
The applicant will check the well location and parking count with his engineers before planning board review.

what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals moved to approve a special permit for two street hockey rinks at 691 Chase Road in the commercial district; the vote count was not audible.
Hours of operation were set at 3 p.m. to 10 p.m. on weekdays and from 7:30 a.m. into the evening on weekends, longer than first requested.
Members questioned the applicants on parking, the well, porta-potties, lighting, hours, season, buffers and traffic.
The applicant said he would check the well location and parking count with his engineers before planning board review.

why_it_matters: The permit sets the hours and conditions for a new recreation use in a commercial area, which bears on evening noise, lighting and traffic for nearby residents.
Because the vote count was not audible in the recording, the written decision is the reliable record of how the board voted and what conditions apply.
